# Appendix A4: Using Positron {#sec-appendix-a4 .unnumbered}

This appendix assumes you've completed [Part 0](../chapters/chapter_00.qmd) —
Python installed, `.venv` created and active, packages installed via
`pip install -r requirements.txt`. Everything below is specific to
working with this book's code in [Positron](https://positron.posit.co),
Posit's data-science-focused IDE.

## Install Positron

Download it from [positron.posit.co](https://positron.posit.co) for your
operating system.

## Open the project folder

`File > Open Folder...` and select the `book/` folder inside your
cloned `llm-ft-drilling-completions-book` repository (this matches the
author's own workflow described in `book/README.md`).

## Select the Python interpreter

Click the interpreter selector in the top-right corner (or bottom
status bar) and choose the `.venv` created in Part 0.

**Expected result:** the console pane shows a Python prompt using that
`.venv`'s packages.

## Run a chapter script

Open `code/chapter_01/load_local_model.py` and click **Run File**, or
select code and press `Ctrl+Enter` / `Cmd+Enter` to run it line by line
in the console — useful for inspecting a model's output interactively.

## Preview a chapter while writing

From the integrated terminal:

```bash
quarto preview chapters/chapter_01.qmd
```

This live-reloads a single chapter in a browser tab as you edit it —
the author's own drafting workflow.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely cause |
|---|---|
| Interpreter selector doesn't list `.venv` | Confirm you opened `book/` (not the repository root) as the workspace, and that `.venv` was created inside it. |
| `quarto preview` command not found | Quarto isn't installed or isn't on `PATH` — see Appendix A, Section 2. |
